cultural.vision_reason: Documentary portrait of a Hill Anga woman with child in sling, showing ear-plugs, bead necklace, headband and traditional hairstyle — clear ethnographic evidence of Anga dress and adornment.

physical.title: photographic print
physical.summary:
Nigeria, head and shoulders portrait of Hill Anga adult female, looking over shoulder at young child carried in sling on her back. Female wearing bead necklace, cylindrical ear-plugs, narrow head-band. Mud wall as backdrop. Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.




. Small group of adult females and a child, sitting on ground outdoors. Wearing personal-ornaments including disc-shaped lip-plugs and ear-plugs, bowl-shaped hair-styles. Two females dressing hair of other two females, using small pointed tools. Female at right holding young child.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.
